sequences.explanation: BTCUSDT episode onset at t precedes ETHUSDT onset in (t,t+3 intervals]. Non-overlapping opportunities; simultaneous excluded. Controls have no active leader during exposure. Inference requires >=80% block coverage, sufficient episodes/controls and disjoint blocks. Short block tails are excluded. Blocks may retain residual dependence. Percentile block bootstrap and follower-block permutations assume stationarity and exchangeability across blocks; block boundaries are censored. One-sided positive association; not causality, forecast performance, or calibrated confidence.
